reason: Our architect already does the 3D models and renders inside their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. And honestly I don't have the bandwidth to take a lunch meeting and learn a new vendor right now.
objection: My architect/in-house team already covers renders in the fee, so $1,500 a home on top is a hard sell, and I don't have the capacity to set up another vendor.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it sells homes faster in a Parade of Homes setting, and a price low enough per plan (a few hundred dollars) that I could just run my whole library through it without anyone on my team having to manage it.
